name: Trees Poker
description: Poker variant with a tree-themed or environmental twist. Players receive five cards face-down, post an ante, and play one round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold) before showdown; highest standard poker hand wins the pot.

content.text: Poker variant with a tree-themed or environmental twist. Players receive five cards face-down, post an ante, and play one round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold) before showdown; highest standard poker hand wins the pot.
Poker spread from the United States in the 19th century. Trees Poker is a thematic variant with tree or environmental twist; specific origin and history are not documented in available sources.
One standard 52-card deck with French suits (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades); no jokers. Same composition as standard poker.
Dealer shuffles; player to dealer's right cuts. Dealer deals five cards face-down to each player, one at a time, clockwise from the player to dealer's left.

items.text: No Limit: Play with no maximum bet; any bet up to full stack is allowed.
